description: This file declares the HealthcheckService class, which implements the IHealthcheckService interface. It manages health check pings for servers, including sending pings, handling acknowledgments, and removing servers. It references external interfaces such as ISessionServerAppManager, ITimer, and ITimerFactory, and defines internal state for managing ping IDs and pending pings.

classes.name: HealthcheckService
classes.description: Implements health check logic for server monitoring, including sending pings and processing acknowledgments.

methods.name: HealthcheckService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the health check service with session manager, timer factory, and interval.

methods.name: onPingSent
methods.description: Handles the event when a ping is sent to a server.

methods.name: onAckReceived
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment receipt from a server, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: onServerRemoved
methods.description: Handles the removal of a server from monitoring.

methods.name: sendPing
methods.description: Internal method to send a health check ping.
